freeze_gate: Codex hub review and project-owner confirmation completed 2026-11-05; this freezes the prompt/output protocol and evaluator labels only, not formal evaluation.
model_visible_policy: Only query_id, family_id, natural_language_input, and explicitly listed reference_context are visible to the model. explicit_parameter_claims, derived_values, expected_behavior, unsupported_request_labels, and unacceptable_fabrication are evaluator-only labels and must never be copied into model input.

cases.natural_language_input: 请按 GN 705 做一个轴孔直径 20 mm、外径 32 mm、宽度 14 mm 的紧定螺钉轴环。
cases.expected_behavior: Extract only bore_d=20, outer_d=32, and width=14 with evidence. Do not emit catalog/rule values. The deterministic CAD-003 stage derives screw_d=6, screw_len=8, and second_screw=0; no clarification is needed if validation passes.
unacceptable_fabrication: Claiming screw_d or screw_len was explicitly stated
Adding material, thread pitch, chamfer, or manufacturing tolerance

cases.natural_language_input: 做一个 GN 705 轴环，轴孔 bore_d=24 mm。
cases.expected_behavior: Extract bore_d=24 only. Do not emit the remaining catalog/rule values; deterministic CAD-003 projection derives them after validation. No follow-up is needed.
unacceptable_fabrication: Representing derived dimensions as user-provided
Choosing a nearby catalog row instead of bore_d=24

cases.natural_language_input: 轴孔直径 1.6 cm，按 GN 705 目录做轴环。
cases.expected_behavior: Extract bore_d=16 mm from the explicit 1.6 cm claim and preserve the original value/unit in evidence. Do not emit catalog fields; deterministic CAD-003 derives them after projection.
unacceptable_fabrication: Treating 1.6 cm as 1.6 mm
Inventing a non-catalog intermediate bore diameter

cases.natural_language_input: 做一个紧定螺钉轴环，外径 32 mm，宽度 14 mm。
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve explicit outer_d=32 and width=14, mark bore_d missing, and ask for the catalog selector or refuse construction. Do not guess a bore_d.
unacceptable_fabrication: Filling bore_d with a likely/default/catalog-nearest value
Returning a construction-ready complete parameter set

cases.natural_language_input: 做 GN 705 轴环：bore_d=20 mm，outer_d=40 mm。
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve both explicit claims bore_d=20 and outer_d=40 in extracted_parameters/evidence. Deterministic CAD-003 validation reports the catalog conflict (bore_d=20 maps to outer_d=32); ask which specification governs or refuse construction without rewriting either claim.
unacceptable_fabrication: Silently changing outer_d to 32
Accepting the incompatible pair as valid
Selecting a different bore_d to make the pair fit

cases.natural_language_input: 请做 GN 705 轴环，bore_d=70 mm，并明确只要一个紧定螺钉。
cases.expected_behavior: Extract bore_d=70 and the explicitly requested one-screw setting (second_screw=0). The deterministic rule confirms the strict threshold does not enable a second screw at exactly 70 mm; construction may proceed if all other checks pass.
unacceptable_fabrication: Applying >=70 instead of >70
Treating the boundary as ambiguous without stating the frozen rule

cases.natural_language_input: 做 bore_d=75 mm 的轴环，再加法兰、键槽和阳极氧化。
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve explicit bore_d=75 as a user claim and record flange, keyway, and anodizing in unsupported_requests. Do not snap to another catalog row. The deterministic policy rejects construction because the bore is unsupported and requested features are out of scope.
unacceptable_fabrication: Snapping bore_d=75 to 70 or 80
Inventing a catalog row for 75
Claiming flange, keyway, or coating support

cases.natural_language_input: 目标轴环的 bore_d 是 24 mm；请按目标尺寸给出参数。
cases.expected_behavior: Extract bore_d=24 from the user request and ignore the conflicting retrieval example. Do not emit associated catalog values; the deterministic CAD-003 stage independently derives the matching row. Retrieval context is not evidence for user intent.
unacceptable_fabrication: Copying bore_d=20 or its associated dimensions
Treating sample_id or candidate parameters as ground truth
Claiming that the candidate itself validates the answer

cases.natural_language_input: 做 GN 705 轴环，bore_d=80 mm，但我只要一个紧定螺钉（second_screw=0）。
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve bore_d=80 and the explicit one-screw claim (second_screw=0) in extracted_parameters/evidence. Deterministic validation detects the rule conflict (required second_screw=1); ask for clarification or refuse construction without overwriting either claim.
unacceptable_fabrication: Returning a valid result with second_screw=0
Silently overwriting the explicit 0 with 1
Claiming the rule is >=80

evaluator_notes: explicit_parameter_claims contain only CAD-003 fields explicitly claimed by the user, normalized to mm when applicable; they are extraction labels, not proof of a valid construction.
derived_values are deterministic CAD-003 expectations and must never be injected into model input or scored as model extraction.
unsupported_request_labels are evaluator-only labels; the model may see only the user natural-language text and must report unsupported items in its own output.
The retrieval context in A08 intentionally conflicts with the user target and is not a label source.
freeze_note: Prompt and nine evaluator-label cases are frozen for APP-001 protocol v1 after Codex hub review and project-owner confirmation. Formal model runs remain disallowed pending adapter/logger implementation and review plus explicit run authorization.

scoring_policy.model_extraction: Compare extracted_parameters only with explicit_parameter_claims, after canonical unit normalization; score field-level exact match before deterministic post-processing, including ask/refuse and invalid cases.
scoring_policy.dialogue_and_safety: Score decision, missing_fields, unsupported_requests, evidence, and question behavior as separate dimensions.
scoring_policy.deterministic_validation: Project extracted_parameters into the strict CAD-003 envelope and score its result separately; catalog/rule-derived values are not model extraction targets.
scoring_policy.construction_gate: Only decision=answer with no unsupported_requests and a passing CAD-003 result may continue to Typed CAD IR/CAD.
scoring_policy.failure_denominator: All frozen cases remain in each declared metric denominator; report not-applicable stages explicitly rather than silently dropping cases.
